method: root visual inspection and independent agent inspection of 3 saved v002 sheets
observed: All three preserve the selected building families and principal visible features.
Right-view labels explicitly mark complementary design.
Control-tower top-plan antenna now shows cap/base instead of upright pole.
Warehouse roof retains two internal long ribs and two side beams.
Component examples and the 24-group catalogue explain static, moving and state-layer boundaries.
limitations: Front/right/top width, depth and height are not pixel-exact aligned; production geometry registration remains required.
Component examples include complete assemblies and subcomponents; some frame examples still carry lamp/leaf. They are not extractable finished atlas cells.
Workshop top view exposes an inferred inner rotor; final external casing must retain the selected reference grille.
Door forms, motion frames, lids, fan animation, binary Alpha, pivots, collision, navigation, interior occlusion and automatic completion are design targets and not implemented/tested.

building_notes.principal_features: two storeys, three observation panes, two lower narrow windows, ordinary door, antenna/hatch/grille
two skylights, ordinary door, front window, fan/elbow and maintenance cabinet
personnel door and cargo shutter, internal twin ribs and side beams, vent and small service unit
